failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'What song appears on The Who's fourth studio album alongside "Overture" and reached top 10 on UK charts and No. 19 on US Billboard Hot 100?' This is a natural-language yes/no question format bundling multiple criteria together, rather than a keyword-based or entity-targeted query structure.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'What song appears on The Who's fourth studio album alongside "Overture" and reached top 10 on UK charts and No. 19 on US Billboard Hot 100?' Hop 3 query: 'What song appears alongside "Overture (The Who Song)" on a fourth studio album and reached the top 10 on the UK charts and No. 19 on the US Billboard Hot 100?' Both queries ask essentially the same question with only minor rephrasing, and both hops returned similar irrelevant documents about various songs' chart performance without The Who information.

failure_modes.name: Missing_Evidence_Not_Specified
failure_modes.evidence: Summary after hop 1: 'None of the songs mentioned in the passages match the specific criteria stated in the claim: reaching top 10 on UK charts, No. 19 on US Billboard Hot 100, and appearing on a fourth studio album alongside "Overture (The Who Song)." The passages do not contain relevant information about this particular song.' The solver recognizes evidence is missing but does not specify concrete missing entities such as 'The Who's fourth studio album' name, 'Overture (The Who Song)' track information, or the specific song title that would have the stated chart positions.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 1 reasoning analyzes all seven passages in detail: 'Passage [1]: "Instant Replay" - peaked at #8 in UK, #29 on Billboard Hot 100 (not top 10 US) / Passage [2]: "Real Real Real" - peaked at #19 on UK Singles Chart and #4 on Billboard Hot 100...' continuing through all passages, when none mention The Who, Overture, or the fourth studio album, making detailed chart comparison analysis unnecessary.
